info.title: binsight
info.description: The HTTP API of a binsight server: health, authentication, live events, the tracked wallets, their synchronization and the settings of the instance. Amounts, prices and percentages are canonical decimal strings; every figure carries its exactness.

post.summary: Signs the owner in with the password and sets the session cookie.

200.description: Signed in; the session cookie is set.

400.description: The body is not a valid login request.

429.description: Too many failed attempts from this client, or from all of them (`too_many_attempts`); retry after the delay.

retry-after.description: Seconds to wait before the next attempt.

post.summary: Signs out: deletes the session cookie. Always succeeds, signed in or not.

204.description: Signed out; the session cookie is deleted.

get.summary: The current session, if the session cookie is valid.
Streams the live events of the server.

200.description: A stream of Server-Sent Events. The `event:` name of each message equals the `type` of its JSON `data`. `engine_status` comes first, then a `heartbeat` every 15 seconds and the other events as they happen. The stream ends when the session expires.

get.summary: Reports the health of the server.

200.description: The server works; `status` says whether the provider answers too (`ok`) or not (`degraded`).

503.description: The database does not answer (`status` is `unavailable`).

get.summary: Reads the overview of every wallet, or of one.

parameters.name: wallet
parameters.description: `all` (the default) or the address of a tracked wallet.

parameters.name: period
parameters.description: `today`, `7d`, `1m` (the default), `3m`, `1y` or `all`.

schema.description:
A period ending now: the last N local dates (today included), from local midnight in the
instance's time zone.

parameters.name: currency
parameters.description: The currency of the figures (`sol` by default).

503.description: The engine does not serve figures yet (`data_not_ready`).

get.summary: Lists the pools of the history.

parameters.name: wallet
parameters.description: `all` (the default) or the address of a tracked wallet.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description:
A symbol (by prefix), a pair (`BONK/SOL`), a token name, or a mint or pool address (by
prefix, from 4 characters); 1 to 64 characters. Exact symbols come first.

parameters.name: address
parameters.description:
Comma-separated pool addresses, at most 20: names the pools a filter already holds. Not
with `search`.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: How many pools at most (20 by default, 50 at most).

503.description: The engine does not serve figures yet (`data_not_ready`).

get.summary: Lists closed positions, a page at a time.

parameters.name: wallet
parameters.description: `all` (the default) or the address of a tracked wallet.

parameters.name: day
parameters.description: Only the positions closed on this local date (`YYYY-MM-DD`).

parameters.name: search
parameters.description:
A symbol (by prefix), a pair (`BONK/SOL`), a token name, or a mint, pool, position address
or position id (by prefix, from 4 characters); 1 to 64 characters.

parameters.name: outcome
parameters.description:
Comma-separated outcomes: `win`, `loss`, `flat` (exactly even, or an empty shell),
`unknown` (the sign is still open). Absent: every closed position.

parameters.name: strategy
parameters.description: Comma-separated strategies: `spot`, `curve`, `bid_ask`. Absent: every strategy.

parameters.name: pool
parameters.description: Comma-separated pool addresses, at most 20 (from `listPools`). Absent: every pool.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: What to sort by (`closed_at` by default).

schema.description: What closed positions are sorted by.

parameters.name: order
parameters.description: The direction (`desc` by default).

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The `next_cursor` of the previous page, with the same filters; absent for the first page.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: How many positions at most (50 by default, 200 at most).

parameters.name: currency
parameters.description: The currency of the figures (`sol` by default).

400.description: A query parameter is invalid (`invalid_request`), or the cursor belongs to another query (`invalid_cursor`: start again from the first page).

503.description: The engine does not serve figures yet (`data_not_ready`).

get.summary: Lists the open positions, sorted, with their totals.

parameters.name: wallet
parameters.description: `all` (the default) or the address of a tracked wallet.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description:
What to sort by (`range` by default: out of range first, longest out first, then the
in-range ones closest to an edge).

schema.description: What open positions are sorted by.

parameters.name: order
parameters.description: The direction (`asc` for `range` and `pair`, `desc` otherwise, by default).

parameters.name: currency
parameters.description: The currency of the figures (`sol` by default).

503.description: The engine does not serve figures yet (`data_not_ready`).

get.summary: Lists the positions closed today and yesterday.

parameters.name: wallet
parameters.description: `all` (the default) or the address of a tracked wallet.

parameters.name: currency
parameters.description: The currency of the figures (`sol` by default).

503.description: The engine does not serve figures yet (`data_not_ready`).

get.summary: Reads one position with its chart.

parameters.name: position_id
parameters.description: The position's permanent id: `<address>-<opening signature>`, both in base58.

parameters.name: currency
parameters.description: The currency of the figures (`sol` by default).

400.description: The id or a query parameter is invalid (`invalid_request`).

404.description: No tracked wallet holds or held this position (`position_not_found`).

503.description: The engine does not serve figures yet (`data_not_ready`).

get.summary: Reads the candles of a position's chart.

parameters.name: position_id
parameters.description: The position's permanent id: `<address>-<opening signature>`, both in base58.

parameters.name: interval
parameters.description: `auto` (the default: the chart's `default_interval`) or one of the chart's `intervals`.

200.description: The candles, or why they are unavailable. Fresh candles of closed positions are cached for a day; live, stale and unavailable responses are not stored.

400.description: The id is invalid, or the interval is not one of the chart's (`invalid_request`).

404.description: No tracked wallet holds or held this position (`position_not_found`).

503.description: The engine does not serve figures yet (`data_not_ready`).

get.summary: Lists a position's movements, newest first.

parameters.name: position_id
parameters.description: The position's permanent id: `<address>-<opening signature>`, both in base58.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The `next_cursor` of the previous page; absent for the newest movements.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: How many movements at most (50 by default, 200 at most).

parameters.name: currency
parameters.description: The currency of the values (`sol` by default).

400.description: The id or a query parameter is invalid (`invalid_request`), or the cursor is not one of this timeline (`invalid_cursor`).

404.description: No tracked wallet holds or held this position (`position_not_found`).

503.description: The engine does not serve figures yet (`data_not_ready`).

get.summary: Reads the settings of the instance.
Reads the existing position detail once and projects it into a client-rendered share card.

parameters.name: position_id
parameters.description: The full permanent id: `<address>-<opening signature>`, both in base58.

parameters.name: currency
parameters.description: The currency of the figures (`sol` by default).

200.description: The position card's data. Rendering is performed by the client.

400.description: The id or currency is invalid (`invalid_request`).

404.description: No tracked wallet holds or held this position (`position_not_found`).

503.description: The engine does not serve figures yet (`data_not_ready`).

parameters.name: wallet
parameters.description: `all` (the default) or the address of a tracked wallet.

parameters.name: period
parameters.description: `today`, `7d`, `1m` (the default), `3m`, `1y` or `all`.

schema.description:
A period ending now: the last N local dates (today included), from local midnight in the
instance's time zone.

parameters.name: series
parameters.description: Which series (`real_pnl` by default).

parameters.name: bucket
parameters.description: The size of the buckets (`day` by default); a window may have at most 1000 of them.

parameters.name: currency
parameters.description: The currency of the figures (`sol` by default).

400.description: A query parameter is invalid, or the window has more than 1000 buckets (`invalid_request`).

503.description: The engine does not serve figures yet (`data_not_ready`).

get.summary: Reports how the instance and each wallet keep up with the chain.

500.description: The database could not be read (`internal`).

parameters.name: mint
parameters.description: The token's mint (base58).

200.description: The logo: a PNG, JPEG, WebP or GIF image, as its `content-type` says.

400.description: The mint is not a valid address (`invalid_request`).

404.description: No logo is stored for this token (`not_found`).

503.description: The engine does not serve figures yet (`data_not_ready`).

get.summary: Lists the tracked wallets with their figures.

parameters.name: currency
parameters.description: The currency of the figures (`sol` by default).

200.description: The tracked wallets and their total.

500.description: The database could not be read (`internal`).

BillingCycle.description: The billing cycle supplied by the credit source.

BinBar.description: One bar of a bin chart.

base.description: Its base token, in whole tokens.

height.description:
Relative depth at each bin’s own price, from `0` to `1` of the largest bar.
Supported pools use the selected native token; unsupported pools show the depth of the
pool's Y token, which never enters a financial figure.

oneOf.description: The price of that bin.

quote.description: Its quote token, in whole tokens.

BinChart.description: A position's liquidity bin by bin (at most 70 bars; bins are grouped beyond).

bars.description: One bar per bin (or group of bins), lowest first.

lower_bin_id.description: The lowest bin of the range.

upper_bin_id.description: The highest bin of the range.

Candle.description: One candle, in quote tokens per base token (the chart's quote token).

oneOf.description: The volume traded, in dollars; `null` when the source does not say it.
Read from the source just now.
Served from the cache while the source fails.
Not available: draw the chart without candles.

retry_after_seconds.description: How long to wait before asking again, in seconds, when known.

CandleStatus.description: Whether candles could be read, tagged by `state`.

ChainTip.description: The last slot the instance saw.

oneOf.description: The exact bin price of its transaction; `null` when the transaction does not say it.

ClosedDay.description: The positions closed on one local day.

items.description: The latest of them, at most 20.

remaining_count.description: How many more closed that day (History shows them).

totals.description: The totals of every position closed that day (today's equal the overview's `today`).

allOf.description: The same figures as in History.

native_pnl.description: Its chosen PnL in the pool’s native quote, before currency conversion.

ClosedPositionDetail.description: A closed position: its row and its chart.

as_of.description: The instant the list is read at, fixed by its first page: later closes are left out.

day_groups.description:
The summary of each local day the page touches, over the whole filtered list; a day cut
by two pages comes twice with the same figures. `null` unless sorted by `closed_at`.

matched_count.description: How many positions match the filters at that instant, over every page.

next_cursor.description: The cursor of the next page; `null` on the last one.

total_count.description:
How many positions of the wallet filter closed by that instant, whatever the other
filters (`matched_count / total_count` in the title).

ClosedPositionRow.description: One closed position. Its figures are exact on their own, even while a wallet imports.

address.description: The position account (it can host several positions over time).

dpr.description: Its PnL per day held (holdings under an hour count as an hour), in percent.

fees_pct.description: The fees as a percentage of what it invested.

held_seconds.description: How long it was held, in seconds.

id.description: Its stable id, `<address>-<opening signature>`; permanent links use it.

is_shell.description: Whether nothing ever moved: an empty shell (its outcome is `flat`).

links.description: External links to the pool, the position account and the displayed base token.

lp_pnl.description: Its liquidity PnL: withdrawn + fees + rewards − invested.

oneOf.description: Its FIFO market PnL, when measured that way.

outcome.description: How it ended; `unknown` while an unpriced movement or reward hides the sign.

pnl_pct.description: Its PnL as a percentage of what it invested.

rewards.description: Farming rewards, separately from swap fees.

oneOf.description: Its strategy; `null` for arbitrary weights or mixed strategies.

ClosedPositionShareCard.description: The data to render a closed position's card; it has no current range or bins.

address.description: Its account address, which earlier positions may have used too.

oneOf.description: Explicit `null`: closed liquidity has no current bins.

fees.description: Claimed swap fees, unchanged from the detail.

held_seconds.description: Seconds between its opening and closing, from the engine row.

id.description: The stable full position identity, including its opening signature.

invested.description: What was invested, unchanged from the detail.

method.description: The same pool or FIFO method as the closed detail.

pnl.description: Its final PnL, preserving exactness and reasons.

pnl_kind.description: The meaning of this card's PnL.

pnl_pct.description: Its PnL percentage from the detail read.

pool.description: Its pool, including the existing token logo references.

oneOf.description: Explicit `null`: closed liquidity has no current range.
Its strategy, or `null` when unknown.

ClosedSharePnlKind.description: The PnL of a closed position.

ClosedTotals.description: The totals of a set of closed positions (every one counts, empty shells as `flat`).

average_held_seconds.description: The mean holding time, in seconds; `null` for an empty set.

flat.description: How many ended flat: exactly even, or empty shells.

median_held_seconds.description: The median holding time, in seconds; `null` for an empty set.

rewards.description: Farming rewards, separately from swap fees.

unknown.description: How many closed positions have an unknown outcome (their PnL sign is still open).

win_rate.description:
`wins / (wins + losses)`: flat and unknown outcomes are left out, and the rate stays
complete. Unavailable without a win or a loss.

CreditsSummary.description: The provider credits of the current billing cycle.

cycle.description: Exact cycle boundaries from the governor, simulated independently in demo mode.

is_over_budget.description: Observed or projected excess; null when neither proves a verdict yet.

projected.description: Expected cycle spending by elapsed seconds; null when no second has elapsed.

Currency.description: The currency figures are shown in.

DataSource.description: Where the figures the API serves come from.

DayGroup.description: The summary of the filtered positions closed on one local day.

flat.description: How many ended flat: exactly even, or empty shells.

unknown.description: How many closed positions have an unknown outcome (their PnL sign is still open).

win_rate.description: `wins / (wins + losses)`: flat and unknown outcomes are left out.

DecimalString.description:
An exact decimal number written as text: no exponent, no `+`, no leading zero, no trailing
zero after the point, never `-0`. For example `"61.541203117"`, `"-0.949"`, `"0"`.

EngineStatus.description: Where the engine is in its lifecycle.

ErrorBody.description: The body of every error response.

ErrorCode.description: Why a request failed. Stable: clients use it as their translation key.

ErrorDetail.description: The content of an error body.

code.description: The stable error code; clients translate it.

message.description: An English explanation for debugging; never shown to users as is.

request_id.description: The id of the request, also in the `x-request-id` response header.

oneOf.description: The lower numeric displayed price; the bin ids are the pool's own. Null without a supported quote.
The upper numeric displayed price; the bin ids are the pool's own. Null without a supported quote.
Exact to the smallest unit.
A lower bound: some inputs could not be valued and are left out.

value.description: The amount of what could be valued.

oneOf.description: Reconstructed rather than measured.
Could not be computed.

Figure.description:
An amount and how far it can be trusted. `value` is present unless the figure is
`unavailable`; `reasons` say why a figure is not `complete`.

Freshness.description:
How fresh a screen's figures are. Freshness never changes a figure's exactness: a lagging
wallet's figures stay exact, only older.

lag_seconds.description: The largest lag of those wallets, in seconds, when known.

state.description: The worst sync state of the wallets they cover.

Gain.description: The real PnL gained over a period.

pct.description: The gain as a percentage of the net worth at the start; `unavailable` for `all`.

value.description: Real PnL now − real PnL at the start (the real PnL series ends on it).

engine.description: Where the engine is in its lifecycle.

oneOf.description: Latest RPC attempt without a probe; null when the application runs no engine.

status.description:
`ok` when every component answers, `degraded` when only the provider or its stream does
not, `unavailable` when the database does not.

oneOf.description: Latest connection/subscription facts; null when the application runs no engine.

HealthStatus.description: The overall verdict of a health check.

ImportProgress.description: The progress of a history import.

eta_seconds.description: How long it should still take, in seconds, when known.

oneOf.description: How far it is, in percent; null when its total is unknown.
How far the import is, in percent; null when its total is unknown.

InstanceSettings.description:
The settings of the instance. Language, theme and density are preferences of each device and
are not here.

default_currency.description: The currency figures are shown in unless a client asks for another.

hide_amounts_by_default.description: Whether clients hide amounts until the owner reveals them.

timezone.description:
The IANA time zone that decides where days start (today, periods, calendars), such as
`Europe/Paris`.

timezone_source.description: `default` until the owner chooses a time zone (clients may then suggest theirs once).

oneOf.description: Sent every 15 seconds so clients can tell a quiet stream from a dead one.
The engine's lifecycle status: sent first on every connection, then on each change.
The monitor changed a tracked wallet's synchronization state.

state.description: The state decided from real ingestion facts.

LiveEvent.description: A message of the live event stream.

LoginRequest.description: A login attempt. Deliberately not `Debug`: it holds the password.

amount.description: The amount in whole units (`"1.5"` SOL), signed for gains and losses.

NetWorth.description: The net worth in its parts.

recoverable_rent.description: The rent closing accounts would give back.

total.description: idle + lp + unclaimed fees + recoverable rent.

unclaimed_fees.description: The fees the open positions could claim.

unpriced.description: The tokens held without a price, left out of the total (which is then `partial`).

OpenMethod.description: How an open position's PnL is measured: at its bins.

allOf.description: The same figures as in the open positions.

native_pnl.description: Its chosen PnL in the pool’s native quote, before currency conversion.

OpenPositionDetail.description: An open position: its row, how fresh it is, and its chart.

oneOf.description: Its PnL per year open, in percent; `null` before a full day.

dpr.description: Its PnL per day open (under an hour counts as an hour), in percent.

links.description: External links to the pool, the position account and the displayed base token.

oneOf.description: The price of the lowest bin of the range.

method.description: Always `pool`: an open position is marked at its bins.

opened_at.description: When it opened (clients compute its age).

pnl.description: withdrawn + claimed fees + rewards + value + unclaimed fees − invested.

pnl_pct.description: Its PnL as a percentage of what it invested.

oneOf.description: The current price (the active bin); `null` when the pool's quote cannot be valued.

range.description: Where the price stands against the range.

rewards.description: Farming rewards, separately from swap fees.

share_of_net_worth.description: Its value as a share of its wallet's net worth.

oneOf.description: Its strategy; `null` for arbitrary weights or mixed strategies.
The price of the highest bin of the range.

OpenPositionShareCard.description: The data to render an open position's card; rendering remains a client operation.

closed_at.description: Explicit `null`: this position has not closed.

fees.description: Claimed and unclaimed swap fees, unchanged from the detail.

held_seconds.description: Seconds held at the engine's shared financial read instant.

id.description: The stable full position identity, including its opening signature.

invested.description: What was invested, unchanged from the detail.

method.description: Open positions are valued at their pool's bins.

pnl.description: Its open PnL, preserving exactness and reasons.

pnl_kind.description: The meaning of this card's PnL.

pnl_pct.description: Its PnL percentage from the detail read.

pool.description: Its pool, including the existing token logo references.

oneOf.description: Its strategy, or `null` when unknown.

OpenPositions.description: The open positions and their totals.

next_cursor.description: Always `null`: the list is never paged.

totals.description: The totals (`value` equals the net worth's `lp`, `unclaimed_fees` its unclaimed fees).

OpenSharePnlKind.description: The PnL of an open position.

out_of_range_count.description: How many are out of range.

pnl_pct.description: Their PnL as a percentage of their net investment.

unclaimed_fees.description: The fees they could claim (the same as the net worth's part).

unclaimed_position_count.description: How many have fees to claim; null while the fees of one of them are not known yet.

OpenTotals.description: The totals of the open positions.

out_of_range_count.description: How many are out of range.

pnl_pct.description: Their PnL as a percentage of their net investment.

rewards.description: Farming rewards, separately from swap fees.

Outcome.description: How a closed position ended, read on the sign of its PnL in the pool's quote token.

gain.description: The real PnL gained over the period.

net_worth.description: The net worth now: `total` is the sum of the four parts.

sync.description: Which wallets lag behind the chain or import their history.

today.description:
The positions closed since local midnight: the same totals as today's recent closes and
History for today.

oneOf.description: The wallet it is about; `null` for every wallet.

watch.description: What deserves attention, most urgent first.

OverviewSync.description: The synchronization of the wallets the overview covers.

oneOf.description: Exact.
Computed from a lower bound.
Computed from reconstructed figures.
Could not be computed (for example a zero denominator).

PercentFigure.description: A percentage (`"2.56"` is 2.56 %) and how far it can be trusted, shaped like [`Figure`].

PnlMethod.description: How a position's PnL was measured.

closed_count.description: How many of its positions closed: what History lists for this pool alone.

last_closed_at.description: When its latest position closed; `null` when none did.

open_count.description: How many of its positions are open.

pool.description: The pool (two pools of one pair differ by `bin_step`).

items.description: The pools: exact symbol matches first, then the latest close first.

next_cursor.description: Always `null`: the list is never paged.

bin_step.description: Its bin step, in basis points.

quote.description: The token prices are expressed in.

oneOf.description: What the quote token is; `null` when binsight cannot value it.

PositionCandles.description: The candles of a position's chart.

candles.description: The candles, oldest first; empty when unavailable.

from.description: The first instant of the chart.

to.description: The last instant of the chart.

PositionChart.description:
The price chart of a position, always in its pool's quote token (never converted to dollars,
so the range band stays exact).

oneOf.description: The price now, for an open position; `null` once closed.

default_interval.description: The candle size that suits the window (what `interval=auto` picks).

from.description: The first instant: a tenth of the position's life before it opened.

intervals.description: Every candle size that draws the window in at most 1000 candles, smallest first.

markers.description: One marker per movement, oldest first.

quote.description: The token prices are expressed in.

ranges.description: The range over time, oldest first (it changes when the position rebalances).

to.description: The last instant: now while open, a tenth of its life after it closed otherwise.

PositionCounts.description: How many positions are open, out of range and closed.

closed.description: How many were closed (as History counts them).

out_of_range.description: How many of the open ones are out of range.

allOf.description: Still open: valued at its pool's active bin.

oneOf.description: Still open: valued at its pool's active bin.
Closed: its figures are final.
The full base token transfer, in whole tokens; `null` for lifecycle or third-mint rewards.
The exact bin price of its transaction; `null` when the transaction does not say it.
The full quote token transfer, in whole tokens; `null` for lifecycle or third-mint rewards.
The range it set, when it opened or rebalanced the position.
A farming reward paid in its own mint, when this movement is a reward claim.

signature.description: Its transaction signature (base58); several movements can share one.

oneOf.description:
The accounting contribution to the header figure, converted at the position's closing
or spot rate. Rebalance halves contribute only their net addition or withdrawal;
base/quote retain their full transfers. Cumulative rounding by category precedes paging.
`null` for lifecycle events; unavailable when a reward's own price is unknown.

PositionEvents.description: A page of movements, newest first.

next_cursor.description: The cursor of the next (older) page; `null` on the last page.

PositionLinks.description: External destinations shared by position lists and details.

gmgn.description: The displayed base token on GMGN, following the pool's selected quote convention.

meteora.description: The DLMM pool on Meteora; does not select a position.

solscan.description: The position account on Solscan, shared by every position that used that address.

allOf.description: A currently open position, with its liquidity range and bins.

oneOf.description: A currently open position, with its liquidity range and bins.

allOf.description: A closed position, with its final holding time and closing instant.

oneOf.description: A closed position, with its final holding time and closing instant.

PositionShareCard.description: A share card's figures are those of its open or closed position.

Price.description: A unit price: quote tokens per base token, with at most twelve significant digits.

quote.description: The token it is expressed in.

PriceQuote.description: The token a price is expressed in.

QuoteKind.description: What a pool's quote token is.

RangeInfo.description: Where the price stands against a range.

composition.description: What the position holds (above the range: only quote; below: only base).

margin_down.description: How far the price can fall to the bottom of the range, in percent (negative outside).

margin_up.description: How far the price can rise to the top of the range, in percent (negative outside).

since.description: Since when it is on that side; `null` when it never moved since the opening.

RangeSide.description: Where the price is against a range.

RangeSpan.description: The range of a position over a span of time.

oneOf.description: The lower numeric displayed price bound; `null` when the quote cannot be valued.

to.description: When it changed or the position closed; `null` while it holds.

oneOf.description: The upper numeric displayed price bound; `null` when the quote cannot be valued.

RangeStatus.description: Where the price stands against a range.

oneOf.description: A wallet holds a token without a price; the figure leaves it out.
Part of the figure comes from before the wallet was added and is reconstructed.

until.description: When it was added (RFC 3339, UTC): what comes before is reconstructed.

oneOf.description: A wallet's history is still being imported.
How far the import is, in percent; null when its total is unknown.
A position movement, reward, liquidity or fee observation has an unpriced token quantity.
A pool is quoted in a token that is neither SOL nor a dollar stablecoin.
This currency conversion uses the still open UTC day’s rate.

day.description: The UTC day that has not closed yet.

oneOf.description: Open PnL is estimated from a mark before the requested historical instant.

age_seconds.description: Whole seconds between the mark and the requested instant.

oneOf.description: Positions were open at the requested instant but no preceding valuation is known.

wallet.description: The wallet whose historical open PnL is unavailable.

oneOf.description: No SOL/USD rate is known for a day the figure needs.
A percentage has a zero denominator.
A profit factor has no loss to divide by.

Reason.description: One reason a figure is partial, estimated or unavailable, tagged by `code`.

RecentCloses.description: The positions closed today and yesterday.

days.description: Today, then yesterday (always both, possibly empty).

oneOf.description: The latest close of all when nothing closed today or yesterday, otherwise `null`.

RegistryCheck.description:
What the startup check of the registry found, before any work started. It reads the database
only and spends no credit.

findings.description: What it found, one entry per kind; empty when every fact of the registry agrees.

RegistryFinding.description: One kind of disagreement the check found, and how many.

count.description:
How many wallets (`wrong_listed_counts`, `unlisted_cursor_points`) or transactions (every
other kind).

kind.description: What disagrees, and what was done about it.

RegistryFindingKind.description:
What the startup check can find, and what was done about it:
`wrong_listed_counts`, wallets counted again; `unlisted_cursor_points`, wallets whose cursor
names a signature they do not list, repaired in full through the credit budget;
`unqueued_signatures`, listed signatures without a fetch task, queued; `fetched_without_payload`,
transactions marked fetched but missing from the registry, fetched again; `stored_but_queued`,
stored transactions still queued, marked fetched; `unreturned_transactions`, listed
transactions the node has not returned yet, tried again; `outdated_decodes`, transactions
decoded again at the current versions; `unordered_transactions`, transactions whose payload
holds no index in its block, which cannot be ordered exactly.

RewardMovement.description: A reward claim in raw units, without assuming the token's decimals or price.

mint.description: The mint paid by the pool's reward program, in base58.

raw_amount.description: A canonical integer string of raw token units, not a human token amount.

reward_index.description: Which reward program of the pool paid it.

RpcStatus.description: The latest completed RPC attempt; health requests never probe the provider.

SeriesHeader.description: The headline figures of a series.

oneOf.description: For the net worth: its change over the window; otherwise `null`.
For the net worth: the capital put in over the window, net; otherwise `null`.

value.description:
The net worth now, the gain (equal to the overview's), or the PnL of the positions
closed in the window.

oneOf.description: The change over the bucket.
The bar as a percentage of the net worth at the start of the bucket.

end.description: The end of its bucket (now for the last one).

line.description: The change since the start of the window (the net worth itself for `net_worth`).

oneOf.description:
The line as a percentage of the net worth at the start of the window (the last point's
equals the gain percentage).

authenticated.description: Always `true`: without a session the API answers `401` instead.

expires_at.description: When the session ends (RFC 3339, UTC); the owner must then sign in again.

points.description: One point per bucket; the first and the last are cut at the window's bounds.

Strategy.description: How a position spreads its liquidity over its bins.

StreamStatus.description: The stream's actual connection and subscription state.

credits.description: The credits of the billing cycle.

engine.description: Where the engine is in its lifecycle.

failed_decodes.description:
How many transactions of the registry could not be decoded; their activity is missing
from the figures until a newer binsight reads them.

oneOf.description: What the startup check of the registry found; null until it ran.

state.description: The worst state of the wallets.

valuation_interval_seconds.description: How often open positions are valued, in seconds, when they are.

wallets.description: Each wallet, in the order of the wallet list.

SyncState.description: How a wallet (or the instance) keeps up with the chain, from the best to the worst.

TimezoneSource.description: Where the time zone setting comes from.

Today.description: The positions closed since local midnight.

totals.description: Their totals; `pnl_pct` is `Σ PnL / Σ invested` of today's closes.

oneOf.description: The SOL coin: clients draw it themselves.
An image served by binsight, same-origin and versioned (cache it forever).
No logo: clients draw a monogram.

TokenLogo.description:
How a client draws a token's logo. Logos are always served by binsight itself, never by a
third party.

TokenRef.description: A token: its mint, its metadata when known, its decimals and how to draw its logo.

decimals.description: The decimals of the mint, read on-chain.

symbol.description: The ticker; `null` when unknown (clients show the short mint).

UnpricedHolding.description: A token held without a price, left out of the net worth.

WalletColor.description: One of the eight wallet colors of the theme.

WalletLinks.description: External destinations shared by every reference to a tracked wallet.

WalletList.description: The tracked wallets and their total.

items.description: Each wallet, in the order they were added.

next_cursor.description: Always `null`: the list is never paged.

WalletRef.description: A tracked wallet: its address, its label and its color.

color.description: Its color in charts and legends.

label.description: Its label: never empty, at most 10 characters (the short address when the owner gave none).

links.description: External links for the wallet account.

WalletSummary.description: One tracked wallet and its figures.

oneOf.description: Its positions; null until the engine counts positions.

real_pnl.description: Its real PnL since its first activity: net worth − net capital put in.

share_of_net_worth.description: Its net worth as a share of the total net worth.

oneOf.description: The progress of the import of its history, while it runs.

indexed_tx.description: How many of its transactions are indexed.

lag_seconds.description: How far behind the chain it is, in seconds, when known.

WalletsTotal.description: The figures of every wallet together.

oneOf.description: Every wallet's positions; null until the engine counts positions.
A position is out of its range.

side.description: Whether the price is above or below the range.

oneOf.description: A wallet holds a token without a price.
A wallet is importing its history.

eta_seconds.description: How long it should still take, in seconds, when known.

oneOf.description: How far it is, in percent; null when its total is unknown.
A wallet is behind the chain.

lag_seconds.description: By how many seconds, when known.

oneOf.description: Observed or projected cycle spending exceeds its budget.

projected.description: Expected cycle spending; null when no second has elapsed.

used.description: Credits already admitted by the source.

WatchItem.description: Something that deserves the owner's attention, tagged by `kind`.

Window.description: The span of time figures cover: from `start` (included) to `end` (excluded).

day.description: The local date (`YYYY-MM-DD`) when `period` is `day`, otherwise `null`.

end.description: The instant right after the window: now, or the next local midnight for a past day.

period.description: The period asked for, or `day` for one local date.

timezone.description: The IANA time zone its days are cut in.

WindowPeriod.description: What a window covers: one of the periods, or one local date.
